notes.title: Added the fast travel feature
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The new update gives you the fast travel feature. You can avoid backtracking and use the fast travel to unlocked houses. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38855297/3557d3033b5e1ab6fb3dfdaf8a800d2a7d457594.jpg[/img]

You can't use fast travel when:

1. You are near the enemies
2. During retrospections
3. You are injured
4. During some tasks

Remember that exploration is vital to find valuable items, herbs, and secret places. 

Please post any bugs or feedback on Last Visit Steam group or by e-mail to pavrekgames@gmail.com

notes.title: Secrets challenge – How many secrets do you able to find
notes.notes:
Last Visit is a survival horror game with an open world. During the game, you will explore a huge village to know a story, solve puzzles and find a lot of items. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38855297/b8acf208ffddb9688c06c23d44def01ac5dd5246.jpg[/img]

Secret items – Find these objects to activate new abilities in the game.

Secret places – The village has lots of secret places. You need to discover them to activate new skills.

Herbs – Collect herbs to create helpful potions.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38855297/2e1d53479e8436a670f4436659b82debc2f8ee37.png[/img]

Photos – There are a lot of photos in the village. Some of them relate to puzzles but others relate to stories and mysterious events.

Tips – While exploring the village you will find envelopes with tips that will help you in the game.

Other secrets – The game has much more mysteries and some of them are not easy to find. Did you find a secret that nobody knows? Make a video and show off that you were first. Good luck!

notes.title: Release date
notes.notes:
Last Visit will be released on [b]August 19th, 2022.[/b]

Grandma Anna invites you to visit her house this vacation. Her house is in Kamby – a village full of forests, meadows, wild animals, and farms.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38855297/d5a51a53755d191e063f613853633ebcda67e691.jpg[/img]

[b]Game features:[/b]

- Atmosphere – The game has atypical lighting. The light of the flashlight resembles a flash from a phone than a standard flashlight and it causes a bigger immersion during the investigation and discovering new places.

- Random scary events – In the game, various scary sounds or monsters appear at random times and places. Thanks to this the gameplay will be a little different for each player.	

- The unique story – It is not another horror game about ghosts or an abandoned house. The story is inspired by Slavic legends where the player gathers information and put it together in a logical whole like puzzles.

- Unpredictable jumpscares – The use of jumpscares in situations that the player does not expect while maintaining logic.

- Task nonlinearity -  Some tasks you can do in a different order.

- A variety of puzzles – Each puzzle is unique and interesting.

- A variety of opponents – In the game, there are a lot of types of enemies with different levels of difficulty and various behavior. Both forest animals and bloodthirsty monsters.

- At least 4 hours of gameplay.
